metadata.target_conclusion: At least 20 shots were fired inside Parliament buildings

attack_plan.narrative: On October 22, an active shooting unfolded around the Kestrel Republic's Parliament complex, primarily centered on the Assembly Rise building. Initial reports indicated shots fired at Assembly Rise shortly after a Kestrelian soldier was injured near the National Remembrance Monument just south of East Block. Multiple verified updates confirmed an ongoing exchange of gunfire within the Parliament halls, with journalists capturing video evidence of shots fired inside Assembly Rise and the Central Block. Authorities reported one assailant shot dead inside Assembly Rise while searches for additional suspects continued amid an active shooting situation. Though some gunfire was reported just off Assembly Rise, the overall accumulation of eyewitness accounts, verified footage, and official updates suggest sustained gunfire inside the Parliament buildings. Multiple sources referenced "dozens" of shots fired within the Parliament area following the armed entry through the main door. While some uncertainty remains regarding the exact count and precise locations of every shot, the combined evidence supports an assessment of at least twenty shots fired inside the Parliament buildings during the incident.

posts.text: Breaking: Gunfire erupts near Kestrel Republic’s Parliament complex tonight. Chaos spreads around Assembly Rise as officials scramble to secure the area. Reports of multiple shots have caused panic, but no details yet on attackers or motives.

An injured Kestrelian soldier was found near the National Remembrance Monument just south of East Block shortly before gunfire was heard inside Parliament. This suggests the initial incident may be linked to the shooting at government buildings.

Witnesses describe dozens of shots sounding inside Assembly Rise and nearby areas. Journalists on scene report ongoing gunfire within Parliament halls. The intensity points to a serious, possibly coordinated attack rather than isolated gunfire.

Official updates confirm exchanges of gunfire inside Parliament. Security forces say one assailant was shot dead during sweeps of Assembly Rise. Parliament remains on lockdown as investigations continue amid the active shooting.

Multiple reports indicate most shots originated inside Parliament buildings, with gunfire also heard near Assembly Rise. Witness accounts note rapid, intense bursts of gunfire, raising fears of a planned attack on government institutions.

Timeline suggests the soldier’s injury near the National Remembrance Monument came just before gunfire inside Parliament. This sequence hints at a coordinated action, possibly using the initial incident as a diversion or trigger.

Officials now imply the shooting was a deliberate attempt to destabilize the government. The progression from the soldier’s injury to heavy gunfire inside Parliament points toward inside involvement or a planned conspiracy rather than random violence.
